_comment: SCCL v5 — FAMILY-STRATIFIED RRV VETO (gold-free gate-coverage fix). Diagnosis from the seed-42 post-mortem (RESEARCH_NOTES_v5.md): the RRV veto checks only skills[-check_skills:], a RECENCY window; the stream order arith->math->string->drift moves the window off older families, so all recorded vetoes broke only active-family skills and arith was NEVER checked during the phases where arith-holdout eroded (0.60 frozen -> 0.40 everywhere). v5 widens the gate's field of view: for learners in sccl_stratified_learners the check pool is the newest ceil(k/F) skill of EVERY certified family (deterministic, no RNG). Fully gold-free — only stored self-tests are re-executed. Ladder (seeded torch_seed=42, compare WITHIN run): frozen (control) / sccl (control; index 1 -> seed 43, must bit-reproduce v3 seed-42: ACC 0.575, arith 0.400) / sccl_strat (v5, k=3 -> ceil(3/4)=1 newest per family = 4 checks; ONLY the pool policy differs from sccl) / vsr_nogold (gold-test ref). STAGED: launch only after the v4 verdict per RESEARCH_NOTES_v5.md. Same stream/hash as v2/v3/v4 (554ce43f182b).
